title: 00169 - P06A3/001699
commonCauses: Faulty wiring on Sensör Okuma Değerleri Reference Voltage "D" Circuit
Faulty sensor or component on Sensör Okuma Değerleri Reference Voltage "D" Circuit
stepByStepSolution: Verify ALL Powers and Grounds for the ECM
Kontrol edin:  wiring on Sensör Okuma Değerleri Reference Voltage "D" Circuit
Kontrol edin:  sensors and components on the Sensör Okuma Değerleri Reference Voltage "D" Circuit
Kontrol edin:  wiring at the ECM with all components removed from the Circuit to verify the reference voltage is present.
